findings.highlight: should at least take out one of your arms
findings.evidenceJa: 腕一本壊死してもおかしくない
findings.governingReading: Rin says the projection was severe enough that necrosis of an entire arm would not be surprising.
findings.explanation: Take out suppresses the concrete tissue death and makes the expected injury vague.

findings.highlight: able to carry Illya home
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤをおんぶして帰ってこれるワケない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cites carrying Illya home on his back as physical proof that his body works.
findings.explanation: Carry omits the piggyback posture that makes his rebuttal concrete.

findings.highlight: this distance reminds me of that night.
findings.evidenceJa: ……本当に異状はないみたいね。
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves directly from Shirou’s tension to Rin’s diagnosis of his arm.
findings.explanation: An English-only branch inserts a long retrospective monologue about the intimate night and Shirou’s ability to speak normally with Rin.

findings.highlight: I pull my arm back to get away from Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: 腕を引いて、遠坂の感触から離れる
findings.governingReading: The narration of Shirou pulling his arm away from Rin’s touch is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted physical staging.

findings.highlight: If it’s none of my business, then you won’t mind me doing this, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 関係ないんなら、わたしがこんなコトしても影響はないわけよねー
findings.governingReading: Rin exploits Shirou’s claim that she is unrelated: if so, her touching his forehead should have no effect on him.
findings.explanation: Won’t mind changes her teasing logical trap about his involuntary reaction into a question of permission or tolerance.

findings.highlight: She smiles maliciously.
findings.evidenceJa: くすり、と意地悪げに笑う
findings.governingReading: The small, teasingly mean smile is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted emotional direction.

findings.highlight: since your reactions are so good
findings.evidenceJa: あんまりにもベタな反応するから
findings.governingReading: Rin says she teased Shirou because his reaction was irresistibly obvious and clichéd.
findings.explanation: Good turns her amusement at his predictable innocence into generic praise for an entertaining reaction.

findings.highlight: The mummy hunter might become the mummy
findings.evidenceJa: ミイラ取りがミイラになりかねない
findings.governingReading: Rin uses an idiom meaning that the person sent to retrieve someone may become caught up in the same condition.
findings.explanation: The unexplained literal mummy hunter is not an English idiom and obscures her hint that teasing Shirou may entangle her too.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka returns to her chair in a good mood.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は上機嫌っぽく椅子に戻る
findings.governingReading: Rin’s cheerful return to her chair is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted staging and a mood judgment.

findings.highlight: will likely make more fun of me as the days go by
findings.evidenceJa: 日増しに俺をからかう率が高くなってないか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the frequency with which Rin teases him has already been increasing day by day.
findings.explanation: The English changes an observed present trend into a prediction about future behavior.

findings.highlight: I don’t like to say this
findings.evidenceJa: いまさら言うのもなんだけど
findings.governingReading: Shirou prefaces an obvious, belated reminder that he came for a serious lesson.
findings.explanation: Don’t like to say expresses reluctance rather than the comic belated obviousness of いまさら.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka turns to me seriously, discarding her earlier lightheartedness.
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでの気軽さとは一変して、遠坂は真剣にこちらを見据える
findings.governingReading: The explicit narration of Rin switching from lightness to a serious stare is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted emotional staging.

findings.highlight: turned the switch on for you that you didn’t use
findings.evidenceJa: 使ってなかったスイッチを取り付けただけ
findings.governingReading: Rin says she merely installed a switch Shirou had not possessed or used, making his trained circuits accessible.
findings.explanation: Turned on changes her intervention from installing the switch to operating an already-present control.

findings.highlight: what you’ve learned
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が体で覚えた魔術
findings.governingReading: Rin can only support the magecraft Shirou has learned through and ingrained in his body.
findings.explanation: What you’ve learned removes the bodily acquisition central to her limit as his teacher.

findings.highlight: She averts her gaze with an unhappy expression.
findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔をして視線を逸らす
findings.governingReading: Rin averts her eyes with a troubled, grave, or difficult expression while considering what she can say.
findings.explanation: Unhappy supplies a simpler emotion and removes the intellectual difficulty of her hesitation.

findings.highlight: I tilt my head questioningly.
findings.evidenceJa: 首をかしげる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s head tilt is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted reaction staging.

findings.highlight: I can just draw whatever I want.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の思うがまま落書きをしているようなもの
findings.governingReading: Shirou compares projection to freely scribbling graffiti with only his own paint.
findings.explanation: The English preserves freedom but removes the deliberately low, careless graffiti image that explains why projection feels easy to him.

findings.highlight: Faker
findings.evidenceJa: 複製者
findings.governingReading: Rin calls such a person a “replicator,” with Faker supplied as ruby over that surface term.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the ruby and discards the semantic surface layer of the coined designation.

findings.highlight: There’s no point in feeling enmity toward Emiya Shirou now.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎に殺意を抱いても仕方ない
findings.governingReading: Rin says there is no point in harboring murderous intent toward Emiya Shirou now.
findings.explanation: Enmity suppresses the explicitly lethal intensity of 殺意.

findings.highlight: reproduces images of existing artwork or weapons using your own magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 実在する美術品とか名剣とか、そういった物を自身の魔力でイメージとして再現する
findings.governingReading: Ordinary Projection reproduces real artworks or famous swords as image-formed objects using the caster’s energy.
findings.explanation: Reproduces images makes the source material itself an image and blurs the distinction between a real model and its image-based substitute.

findings.highlight: a reproduction made out of illusions
findings.evidenceJa: イメージで編み上げる複製品
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands the projected object as a replica woven from an image.
findings.explanation: Illusions plural substitutes a different magical concept for the mental image used as the construction pattern.

findings.highlight: mixing magical energy like toffee
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を飴のようにこねて
findings.governingReading: Rin describes kneading magical energy like candy into a dagger shape.
findings.explanation: Mixing removes the plastic shaping action needed for her candy analogy.

findings.highlight: takes these things with only shape and make the ability close to the original’s as well
findings.evidenceJa: 外見も性能もオリジナルに近づける
findings.governingReading: Projection brings both the appearance and performance of a merely shaped construct closer to the original.
findings.explanation: The English omits appearance, reduces performance to singular ability, and breaks subject-verb agreement.

findings.highlight: it lasts a hundred times longer than ‘projection’
findings.evidenceJa: その持続時間は“投影”の何百倍
findings.governingReading: Rin says Strengthening lasts hundreds of times longer than Projection in her illustrative comparison.
findings.explanation: A hundred converts an open hundreds-fold comparison into the fixed value one hundred.

findings.highlight: magical energy that’s a hundred times what I have
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の何百倍っていう魔力
findings.governingReading: Shirou marvels at imitating energy hundreds of times greater than his own.
findings.explanation: The English again replaces hundreds with the exact value one hundred.

findings.highlight: these magi end up as specialists
findings.evidenceJa: そういう魔術師は中央には入れず、突出した専門家として名を馳せる
findings.governingReading: Magi with subdivided attributes cannot enter the institutional center and instead gain fame as exceptional specialists.
findings.explanation: The English drops both their exclusion from the center and their exceptional fame, leaving a neutral career category.

findings.highlight: you can try and be the best when it comes to swords
findings.evidenceJa: 剣に関しては頂点を狙える
findings.governingReading: Rin says the sword attribute gives Shirou the potential to aim for the pinnacle in that domain.
findings.explanation: Try and be the best sounds like encouragement to exert effort rather than a claim about exceptional potential.

findings.highlight: Does that mean she has all of them…?
findings.evidenceJa: 全部持ってらっしゃるっというコトでしょうか
findings.governingReading: Still addressing Rin, Shirou internally frames the overwhelmed question as whether she possesses all five.
findings.explanation: She shifts the immediate address into detached third-person reference and weakens the comic over-polite reaction.

findings.highlight: Projection is so useless that it’s even called vanity
findings.evidenceJa: 投影は虚影って言われる
findings.governingReading: Projection is disparaged as a “phantom image,” linking the label to its insubstantial product.
findings.explanation: Vanity is the wrong sense and breaks the terminology-to-mechanism relation.

findings.highlight: magi always have death right beside them
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師は死と隣り合わせ
findings.governingReading: Magi live perpetually side by side with death because they can exceed safe limits.
findings.explanation: Have death right beside them is an awkward literal calque that obscures the established danger idiom.

findings.highlight: you can go over the speed limit
findings.evidenceJa: 規定以上のスピードは出る
findings.governingReading: An over-revved small engine can exceed its rated or specified speed until it destroys itself.
findings.explanation: Speed limit suggests a legal road limit rather than the engine’s design rating, weakening the mechanical analogy.

findings.highlight: if you keep on turning the magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を回転させていけば
findings.governingReading: The magus keeps magical energy circulating even as circuits and nerves burn apart.
findings.explanation: Turning the magical energy is nonidiomatic and obscures circulation through the bodily system.

findings.highlight: it would be natural for you to lose an arm or two
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の一本や二本、壊れて当然
findings.governingReading: Damage to one or two hands or feet—limbs—is presented as a natural consequence of Shirou’s act.
findings.explanation: Arm or two excludes the legs and changes bodily breakdown into limb loss alone.

findings.highlight: She’s angry at me.
findings.evidenceJa: 叱咤する声
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears a stern, exhorting voice and then recognizes concern within it.
findings.explanation: The English replaces an observable vocal act with a flat assertion of Rin’s emotional state.

findings.highlight: make the caster a cripple
findings.evidenceJa: 術者を廃人にする
findings.governingReading: Magecraft beyond one’s limit can reduce its practitioner to a ruined or incapacitated state.
findings.explanation: A cripple narrows the possible total physical and mental ruin to a bodily disability label.

findings.highlight: tries to prescribe me another medicine
findings.evidenceJa: まだ違う薬を処方しようとしている
findings.governingReading: Rin searches her belongings to give or prepare another medicine for Shirou.
findings.explanation: Prescribe assigns formal medical authority and procedure absent from the scene.
